name: Whisky Brother
status: active - one of two active whisky vendors alongside whisky-twins

contact.note: Not yet contacted. Physical store in Hyde Park, Johannesburg, with free in-store collection as an alternative to delivery.

delivery.note: Confirmed via https://www.whiskybrother.com/pages/delivery-details : orders R1,200+ ship free nationwide (Gauteng included); under that, a flat R150 courier fee applies.

constraints: SA delivery addresses only for the free tier - international shipping exists but is explicitly expensive/discouraged.
Not yet confirmed: minimum bottle count per order, case/mixed-case rules.
evaluation_note: Stock breadth confirmed strong across Scotch/Irish/Japanese categories: 231 Scotch single malt SKUs (Ardbeg R690-R39,000, Glenmorangie R530-R3,500 incl. the 12YO at R640, Talisker R1,110-R15,000, Aberlour R1,150-R2,895 incl. 12YO at R1,150), 43 Irish SKUs R290-R2,930 (Redbreast 12YO R1,570, Tullamore Dew confirmed in stock), 15 Japanese SKUs (Hibiki Harmony R2,250, Nikka From The Barrel R6,300+ as a set, Kamiki R1,200-R1,320, plus Suntory Toki R615). Real price spread from ~R500 to ~R2,000+ gives headroom both above and below a typical whisky buyer's day-to-day/feeling-lush range.
